profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, CoreAI at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Interests:
* Mixed Reality (AR/VR)
* Distributed cloud services
* Compiler
* Communication Theory
* Signal Processing

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, CoreAI
positions.description: Contributing to the development of products like Azure API Management, AI Gateway, AI Foundry, etc

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Teams Premium Services
positions.description: Contributed to the development of Teams Premium cloud services for enabling large townhalls and webinars.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Mixed Reality
positions.description: Working on Mixed Reality (AR/VR) online distributed cloud services and applications such as Azure Spatial Anchors, Synthetics, Azure Remote Rendering, Microsoft Mesh

positions.title: C/C++ Software Engineer, Simulink Code Generation
Embedded Coder Quality Engineer
positions.description:
* Mainly responsible for testing features developed for the Code Replacement Library (a code generation capability that allows inclusion of target optimized code)
* Created and maintained tests as well as verified code changes and bug fixes for Simulink code generation products
* Created/ improved tools and scripts used for testing
* Simplified/ identified software issues uncovered by the testing infrastructure

positions.title: Application Support Engineer
positions.description:
* Technical Specialist in the Signal Processing and Communications and Control Design Automation Team providing support for Simulink and related products
* Key department resource for complex customer issues in Signal Processing and Communications
* Developed and performed technical reviews of training materials on Signal Processing and Communications concepts
* Worked on development projects such as: Communication System Object algorithms and demos; Beagleboard code generation user interface prototypes

positions.title: Research Fellow
positions.description:
* Conducted research on MIMO communication systems in collaboration with InterDigital, Inc.
* Contribute to the development of novel ways to improve raw BER performance of the 3GPP Release 7 standard.
* Implemented the transmitter, channel, and receiver using MATLAB to analyze new system features
